<!-- pr-reviewer: 5e5435f4f8e162f6d2fa8476bb6039b2f67632d7 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good
- No collision or gouge check is changed. The PR changes only how the boundary region is read. Everything after that point is the same code.
- Unclear edge selections are refused by name: chains that touch or cross, a chain with the operation area evenly on both sides, a Contour given two chains, and an include or exclude made of separate chains.
- The new code is in `camcraft-geometry`, with no new `camcraft-*` dependency line. A decision file is included.
- No file in `tests/golden/` is changed, and no snapshot PNG is changed.
- The merge with current main is clean. The changes of #1769, #1781 and #1748 in `boundary.rs`, `boundary_ctx.rs` and `picks.rs` are kept.

## Results (locally, merged with main at the time of review)
- `camcraft-geometry` lib and `boundary_chains`: 41 and 1 passed.
- `camcraft-app` lib: 311 passed. Suites `area_chains` 4, `area_open` 11, `area_picks` 5, `contour_open_side` 2, `golden_cl` 33, `mcp_pick` 7, `open_band` 7, `pick_doors` 8, `slot_pick_refusals` 3, `stitch_cross` 6: all passed.
- `camcraft-ui` lib filtered to `edge_click_modifiers` and `boundary`: 9 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Mutation check: I disabled the equal-area tie refusal in `sides_of_chains`. `the_area_lies_between_the_chains_and_a_tie_is_refused` failed. I restored the line.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
- `crates/geometry/src/boundary_chains.rs`: the tie test uses a 1 percent margin. A chain that splits the area 49 to 51 is accepted. This is a defined rule and it is pinned. Consider naming the constant.
- The author states that the quick gate shows `winding_align` red on the base. I did not run that suite. It is not touched by this diff.
- Not run: the full app and ui suites, clippy for the other crates, Windows-only readings, release lanes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
